meta.name: debug-broken-ui
meta.description: Find out why something in a running web app does not work, when the console is empty and the code looks correct. Reads the click, the request, the store and the console together and returns the file:line to open. Use when a button does nothing, a form will not submit, data will not load, a page renders blank or stale, a modal will not close, or the user says "it's broken" and the code review says it is fine.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪运行中网页应用的交互故障,给出发出问题的文件与行号
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网页上的点击或加载失效,但代码审查看起来没问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if something in your web app is broken but the code looks fine

howto.what: 当运行中的网页应用某个地方不工作时，Claude 会从页面内部同时读取点击、请求、状态库和控制台，定位问题后返回该打开的 file:line，而不是只给推测。修复前会重跑复现步骤确认。
howto.when: 当按钮没反应、表单提交不了、数据加载不出来等情况，且控制台为空、代码看起来正确时触发。

say.text: 这个按钮点了没反应，控制台也没报错，帮我看看是哪里坏了。
say.note: 会驱动这次点击并读取结果，最后给出要打开的文件和行号。

say.text: 数据加载不出来，但接口请求看着正常，帮我诊断一下问题在哪。
say.note: 会把网络、状态库和控制台的读取限定在这次操作范围内。

say.text: 表单提交不了，帮我找出是流程里哪一步断掉了。
say.note: 按步骤跑一遍流程，指出第一个失败的步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the click, request, store and console together from inside the running page, finds why a web app misbehaves, and returns the file:line to open instead of a theory. It re-runs the reproduction to confirm a fix.
howto.when_en: Use when a button does nothing, a form will not submit or data will not load, etc., and the console is empty while the code looks correct.

say_en.text: This button does nothing and the console is empty — find where it breaks.
say_en.note: Drives the click, reads the result, returns the file:line.

say_en.text: Data will not load but the request looks fine — diagnose it.
say_en.note: Reads network, store and console scoped to that action.

say_en.text: The form will not submit — find which step fails.
say_en.note: Runs the steps and reports the first failing one.
